product-2.name: Power Filter
product-2.description:
IH-0342-H is a 3A 250V AC single-phase EMI power filter.
It is used to suppress electrical interference on the AC mains line.
It has a metal enclosure and panel mounting and is generally used in power supplies, monitors and industrial equipment. It operates at 50–60 Hz, has a current capacity of 3 A and has international safety certifications such as CQC, TÜV, VDE and UL.
